decisions.statement: The points before today are the messages over the counted days short of today.
The day now open is counted from six in the morning in New York.
Today itself is left out of the points before today.
Today's points are the messages on today's own day.
A persona's three figures agree once the rebuild ends.
A persona written to only today has nothing before today.
A name no persona is filed under is said rather than kept against nobody.
A persona written to on no counted day keeps the figure that persona already had.
The rebuild is run by a workstation timer once the day has opened as well as by hand.
Each persona rebuilt is named as soon as that persona's points are kept.
A run hands the list it was handed down, so a run that threw names each persona it rebuilt.
Nothing here works out the rung a total reaches.

definition: each persona's points, worked out again from the days her messages were counted on
